chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hamid, from Abu Jameela, from one of his companions, who said:
When the man denies the truth, and if you intend to perform mubahala (imprecation) with him, say:

O Allah, Lord of the seven skies and Lord of the seven earths, and Lord of the Magnificent Throne! If so-and-so has denied the truth and disbelieved in it, then send down upon him a reckoning from the sky or a painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the correct Arabic text for the mubahala supplication when denying the truth?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith outlines the specific liturgical formula for mubahala, emphasizing the invocation of Allah as Lord of the seven heavens and earth to bring divine reckoning upon the denier. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of using this supplication as a means of validating truth through divine intervention when faced with denial. The text highlights the theological weight of 'denial' (jahd) as a form of disbelief warranting severe punishment.
